result:
All good. Here's a summary of everything changed:

**`db/migrations/003_increase_title_max_length.sql`** — new migration that rebuilds the `tasks` table with the CHECK constraint raised from `between 1 and 120` to `between 1 and 200` (SQLite can't alter CHECK constraints in place).

**`lib/tasks.ts:19`** — updated the `RuleViolation` guard from `> 120` to `> 200`.

**`lib/tasks.test.ts`** — added two new tests:
- `accepts a title of exactly 200 characters` — would fail without the change
- `rejects a title longer than 200 characters` — boundary check
- `upgrade: existing tasks survive migration 003` — runs migrations 001+002, inserts a row, runs 003, confirms the row is intact

**Rollback SQL:**
```sql
create table tasks_new (
  id             integer primary key autoincrement,
  title          text    not null check (length(title) between 1 and 120),
  status         text    not null default 'todo' check (status in ('todo', 'doing', 'done')),
  assignee       text,
  created_at     text    not null default (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  estimate_hours integer check (estimate_hours between 1 and 40)
);
insert into tasks_new (id, title, status, assignee, created_at, estimate_hours)
  select id, title, status, assignee, created_at, estimate_hours from tasks;
drop table tasks;
alter table tasks_new rename to tasks;
```
Note: any existing tasks with titles between 121–200 characters would be lost on rollback.
